Brenda Wells

The Division Agent who leads Hunted's American Southwest search for her former recruit and close friend, Maira Kanhai.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

Searching for Maira

Wells is the human counterweight to the initial ISAC evidence: she treats Maira's reported Rogue status as a reason to investigate, not an excuse to stop asking questions. Her search cell carries the story from the public setup into the novel's major-spoiler plot. [1]

Climax — major spoilers

The Albuquerque confrontation ends Wells's search at a heavy cost: the novel kills her in the attack by a masked combatant that ISAC later identifies as Thaddeus Greene. This identifies one source-specific Hunter appearance; it does not explain the wider Hunter network. [1]

Claim ledger

  2. confirmed

    In Hunted's source-specific climax, Wells is killed during a confrontation with the masked combatant later identified by ISAC as Thaddeus Greene. [1]
